rationale.risk-routing: Delegation decision matrix and tier transition criteria allocate human validation effort.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Specifies autonomy tiers and oversight checkpoints integrated into agile team workflows.
rationale.framework: Proposes HAIF, a reusable protocol architecture for governing hybrid team operations.
rationale.design-only: Specifies framework mechanics and thresholds without empirical evaluation on real data.
rationale.assistive: Models human-driven work with AI support as its base autonomy tier.
rationale.agentic: Models bounded autonomous AI agents producing deliverables requiring periodic human audit.
rationale.risk-quality: Mitigates quality degradation through structured validation checklists and tier demotions.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Mitigates skill erosion and dependency through mandatory human-only execution cycles.
